question: Where should placement be made after uttering the mantra udbhavāya namaḥ?
premises: The mantra udbhavāya namaḥ is to be uttered.
The placement action follows the utterance.
The specified location is the side of the left arm.
inference: After uttering udbhavāya namaḥ, one should place on the side of the left arm.
uncertainties: The specific kalā to be placed is not named in this verse.
plain_english: Having uttered ‘udbhavāya namaḥ’, one should place on the side of the left arm.
